latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides expert review of AI agent instruction files (SOUL.md, SKILL.md, system prompts).
- Scores files across 7 dimensions: clarity, completeness, conflict detection, voice, guardrails, token efficiency, and structure.
- Supports multiple user modes: paste review, design questions, version comparison, and first draft generation.
- Offers specific, actionable feedback with concrete rewrites and teaching behind each suggestion.
- Includes stress testing with simulated prompts to assess instruction robustness.
